name: Chittorgarh

queries.query: Chittorgarh Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map land records BhuNaksha
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Rajasthan Apna Khata, Rajasthan BhuNaksha, Rajdharaa Urban GIS, and an official Chittorgarh municipal cadastral/map PDF. The public viewers expose map/search functionality, but discovery did not expose an anonymous parcel JSON/API response.

queries.query: चित्तौड़गढ़ राजस्थान भू नक्शा आधिकारिक खसरा नक्शा जमाबंदी
queries.result: First-party Hindi-language discovery identified the Rajasthan Government Revenue Board Apna Khata portal and its Bhu Naksha link. The indexed portal states that Rajasthan agricultural land-record copies are available online and links to e-Dharti and Bhu Naksha; no bounded anonymous parcel feature response was exposed.

registryEvidence: Rajasthan Government Revenue Board's official Apna Khata portal links Bhu Naksha and describes the state's e-Dharti land-record programme. Rajasthan's official BhuNaksha viewer is a cadastral map service, and the Rajasthan Urban GIS portal states that its khasra and village boundaries come from the Settlement Department. An official Rajasthan urban-local-body Chittorgarh PDF visibly contains a cadastral/map sheet. This evidences a state/local cadastral-map custodian and public map leads, not a qualified parcel API response.

officialSources.observation: Official Rajasthan Revenue Board Apna Khata page; links e-Dharti and Bhu Naksha and states that online agricultural land-record copies are available for information use.
Official Rajasthan/NIC BhuNaksha entry page; public cadastral map viewer lead. Direct workspace retrieval timed out before JavaScript/configuration inspection.

Official Rajasthan Urban GIS page exposes District, Tehsil, Village, Khasra No., View On Map and View Khasra Info controls. Its disclaimer attributes khasra/village boundaries to the Settlement Department and says final authentication rests with the concerned local body/town-planning records.

Official Rajasthan urban local-government PDF titled M.C. CHITTORGARH; indexed visual evidence shows a cadastral/map sheet with parcel outlines and numbered areas. It is a static map document, not a machine-readable parcel API.

source: Rajasthan Revenue Board Apna Khata / NIC BhuNaksha / Rajdharaa Urban GIS (public cadastral-map leads; direct parcel API not verified)
